## About
A Bug Guy Pest Services is a local, family owned business. We work in Allen, Celina, Fairview, Frisco, Little Elm, McKinney, Melissa, Plano, Prosper and The Colony, and we'd rather stay close to home and do the job right.
Every pest company has access to the same products. The difference is the person applying them. We inspect, evaluate, advise and educate, and then we spray if it's needed. We treat your home like our own.
Reviewers name Sam and Sarah, and they talk about questions answered with patience and problems that went away. We have a 5 star rating from 34 Google reviews.

## Services
- Bug Barrier: Our preventative program for your home. We target entry points, harborage areas and the things that draw insects in. Choose the Essential, Preferred or Max package.
- Mosquito control: Reclaim your patio, gazebo, pool and backyard with monthly treatment tailored to your home. (Starting at $77)
- Rodent control: Tailored to your home, with bait kept in secured tamper resistant boxes. (Starting at $77)
- Fire ants: Don't step in one of these mounds. A yearly treatment that also controls other bugs. (Starting at $127)
- Termite Control: A careful inspection, then honest recommendations. Options include bait stations that monitor year-round and liquid treatments that form a continuous barrier.
- Commercial Services: The same quality service for your business, from restaurants and coffee shops to daycares, offices and warehouses.

## FAQ
Q: Do I have to sign a contract?
A: No. We don't do contracts. If we're doing a good job, you'll keep us around.

Q: How do you quote a job?
A: Give us a call or send a text. Tell us what kind of insects you're seeing, the size of the building and lot, and details like a pool or detached garage. No appointment needed.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Allen, Celina, Fairview, Frisco, Little Elm, McKinney, Melissa, Plano, Prosper and The Colony.

Q: How can I pay?
A: You can pay monthly, pay per service, or make a one-time payment.

Q: Are these flying ants or termites?
A: Save a few in a sealed bag or take a close-up photo, and we're happy to help identify them.
